review.note: Drafted from NCDOT Strategic Plan 2025-2029. Human review and sign-off required before scoring results are trusted.

scope_notes: NCDOT manages NC's transportation network: highways, bridges, transit, rail, aviation, bicycle and pedestrian facilities. DMV-related items (licensing, vehicle registration) should be capped at Medium confidence until NCDMV's own plan is added.

matching_units.title: Improve safety for all transportation users
matching_units.summary: Reduce fatal and serious injury crashes, improve work zone safety, and address high-risk road segments. NCDOT leads Vision Zero-aligned programs.

matching_units.title: Preserve and maintain infrastructure assets
matching_units.summary: Maintain bridges, pavements, culverts and other transportation assets in good condition to avoid costly replacements. Prioritize asset management and state of good repair.

matching_units.title: Modernize and expand transportation infrastructure
matching_units.summary: Build new capacity, improve interchanges, widen key corridors, and address system bottlenecks to support NC's growth.

matching_units.title: Reduce congestion and improve mobility
matching_units.summary: Improve travel time reliability and reduce congestion on key corridors through operational improvements, ITS, and demand management.

matching_units.title: Expand multimodal transportation options
matching_units.summary: Increase access to transit, passenger rail, bicycle, pedestrian, and micromobility options to serve all users and reduce car dependency.

matching_units.title: Operate and maintain our system efficiently
matching_units.summary: Maximize value and efficiency of existing assets through data-driven operations, performance measurement, and technology.

matching_units.title: Support economic development and freight movement
matching_units.summary: Improve freight corridors, port and airport access, and transportation connections to support NC's economy and global competitiveness.

matching_units.title: Environmental stewardship and climate resilience
matching_units.summary: Address climate change impacts on transportation infrastructure, reduce vehicle emissions, and protect natural resources.

matching_units.title: Equity and community connectivity
matching_units.summary: Ensure transportation investments serve all communities, including rural, low-income, tribal, and historically underserved populations.

matching_units.title: Technology and innovation
matching_units.summary: Deploy emerging technologies such as connected/autonomous vehicles, smart infrastructure, and advanced data analytics.

matching_units.title: Workforce development and organizational excellence
matching_units.summary: Build NCDOT's workforce capacity, partner with educational institutions, and attract transportation professionals.

matching_units.title: Safety culture and Vision Zero
matching_units.summary: Embed safety in all NCDOT decisions and programs, with a long-term goal of zero transportation fatalities and serious injuries.

matching_units.title: Rural and small community transportation
matching_units.summary: Address the unique transportation needs of rural communities and small towns across North Carolina.
